definition.zh-TW:
存貨平均要在帳上停留幾天，才隨著銷貨轉成營業成本。

算法是一年 365 天除以存貨週轉率；週轉次數越多，每批貨停留的天數越短。
definition.en:
The average number of days inventory stays on the books before it is sold and becomes cost of sales.

It is 365 days divided by inventory turnover; the more turns a year, the fewer days each batch stays.

example.zh-TW: 它由存貨週轉率換算而來，週轉率是 N/A 或 0 時它也是 N/A。台灣的財務分析資料也常稱它為平均售貨日數；加上平均收現日數就是營運週期。
example.en: It is derived from inventory turnover and is N/A whenever the turnover is N/A or zero. Taiwanese financial analysis data often call it average days to sell goods; adding the average collection period gives the operating cycle.

misconception.zh-TW: 用 12 個月除以週轉率，得到「月」卻當成「天」。公式固定用 365 天，單位是天；換算基準弄錯會差三十倍。
misconception.en: Dividing 12 months by the turnover and reading the result as days. The formula uses 365 days and the unit is days; mixing up the base gives a figure thirty times too small.

formula.zh-TW: 平均銷貨日數的算法：365 ÷ 存貨週轉率。
formula.en: Average days to sell inventory = 365 ÷ inventory turnover.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
